description: Canonical Pydantic schemas package + Alembic migration (IngestionRun table, DataSource mapping/secret_ref columns, AuditRecord ingestion_run_id) + ORM model updates. This is the data layer foundation that FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 both depend on. Must be completed first.
steps: Create directory packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/schemas/ and add __init__.py that exports SalesLine, TelemetryFrame, WeighbridgeSlip, Invoice, PurchaseOrder.

Create packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/schemas/sales.py: SalesLine(BaseModel) with fields line_id:str, org_id:str, sku:str, category:str, quantity_units:float, unit_weight_kg:float, sale_date:date, gstin_buyer:Optional[str]=None.

Create packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/schemas/telemetry.py: TelemetryFrame(BaseModel) with fields frame_id:str, org_id:str, plant_id:str, timestamp:datetime, energy_kwh:float, mass_processed_kg:float, motor_load_pct:Optional[float]=None, power_factor:Optional[float]=None.

Create packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/schemas/logistics.py: WeighbridgeSlip(BaseModel) with fields slip_id:str, org_id:str, plant_id:str, vehicle_id:str, gross_weight_kg:float, tare_weight_kg:float, net_weight_kg:float (Pydantic v2 @model_validator(mode='after') asserts abs(net_weight_kg - (gross_weight_kg - tare_weight_kg)) < 0.01), slip_date:date, eway_bill_ref:Optional[str]=None. Also Invoice(BaseModel): invoice_id:str, org_id:str, seller_gstin:str, buyer_gstin:str, line_items:list[dict], total_amount:float, invoice_date:date.

Create packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/schemas/po.py: PurchaseOrder(BaseModel) with po_id:str, org_id:str, recycler_org_id:str, volume_tons:float, unit_price_inr:float, category:str, po_date:date.

Create Alembic migration packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/versions/d4e5f6a7b8c9_phase4_data_onboarding.py with revision='d4e5f6a7b8c9', down_revision='c1d2e3f4a5b6'. upgrade(): (1) op.create_table('ingestion_runs', sa.Column('id', sa.String(64), primary_key=True), sa.Column('org_id', sa.String(64), sa.ForeignKey('organizations.org_id'), nullable=False), sa.Column('data_source_id', sa.String(64), nullable=False), sa.Column('schema_type', sa.String(32), nullable=False), sa.Column('rows_read', sa.Integer(), nullable=True), sa.Column('rows_accepted', sa.Integer(), nullable=True), sa.Column('rows_quarantined', sa.Integer(), nullable=True), sa.Column('source_hash', sa.String(64), nullable=True), sa.Column('schema_fingerprint', sa.String(64), nullable=True), sa.Column('status', sa.String(32), server_default='pending', nullable=False), sa.Column('error', sa.Text(), nullable=True), sa.Column('created_at', sa.DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=sa.func.now(), nullable=False), sa.Column('completed_at', sa.DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)). Wrap try/except around RLS ALTER TABLE/CREATE POLICY for ingestion_runs (same pattern as c1d2e3f4a5b6). (2) op.add_column('data_sources', sa.Column('mapping', sa.JSON(), nullable=True)). (3) op.add_column('data_sources', sa.Column('secret_ref', sa.String(256), nullable=True)). Add comment: '# TODO Phase 5: drop connection_config after Secret Manager migration is complete'. (4) op.add_column('audit_records', sa.Column('ingestion_run_id', sa.String(64), nullable=True)). downgrade() reverses all four changes.

Add IngestionRun SQLAlchemy ORM class to packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/models/organization.py: id (String 64 PK default uuid4 hex), org_id (String 64 FK organizations.org_id), data_source_id (String 64), schema_type (String 32), rows_read/rows_accepted/rows_quarantined (Integer nullable), source_hash (String 64 nullable), schema_fingerprint (String 64 nullable), status (String 32 default 'pending'), error (Text nullable), created_at (DateTime TZ server_default now), completed_at (DateTime TZ nullable). Add relationship back to Organization.
Add mapping: Mapped[dict | None] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=True) and secret_ref: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(256), nullable=True) to the DataSource class in organization.py.
Add ingestion_run_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True) to AuditRecord class in organization.py.
Export IngestionRun from packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/models/__init__.py (add to imports and __all__).
Update api/tests/conftest.py: add IngestionRun to the import list inside setup_test_db so the in-memory SQLite creates the table.
